test_cases.test_scenario: BUSINESS FLOW 5: COURSE STRUCTURE MANAGEMENT (DELETION & ORGANIZATION) - Phase 3: Manage and Delete Sessions
test_cases.pre_condition: A Teacher with a pre-provisioned account ('GiangGiangteacher@gmail.com') is logged in and has navigated to the 'Sessions' tab of the 'Course Details Page'. At least one session, specifically 'Introduction to Software Testing' (created in TC-004), exists in the session list.
test_cases.expected_result: The session 'Introduction to Software Testing' is deleted from the course's session list. The system displays the updated session list, confirming the successful deletion of the session. A confirmation message should be displayed to the Teacher.
test_cases.post_condition: The session 'Introduction to Software Testing' is permanently removed from the course. The Teacher remains on the 'Sessions' tab of the 'Course Details Page' with the updated session list displayed.

test_steps.step: Locate the session 'Introduction to Software Testing' in the 'Session List'.
Click the 'Delete Button' next to the session 'Introduction to Software Testing'.
Confirm the deletion in the confirmation dialog by clicking 'Confirm'.
